commands.command: TBD: audit hidden-envelope probe target distributions, train/test split variance, larger sample counts, and repeated split seeds before another objective
commands.name: m109_hidden_envelope_probe_reliability_audit

decision_rule: Diagnose whether hidden-envelope probe failures come from target distribution shift, train/test split instability, insufficient samples, or genuinely weak recurrent belief before training another objective.
failure_criteria: a new hidden-retention objective is trained before probe reliability is diagnosed
single train/test split R2 is treated as a stable self-identification proof
the audit uses hidden physics as deployable actor input
hypothesis: M108 showed all current checkpoints fail the multi-seed hidden-envelope gate. The next blocker is measurement reliability: the probe target distributions or train/test split may be too unstable for admission decisions.
success_criteria: target distributions are summarized by probe seed
train/test split variance is measured or bounded
larger sample or repeated split settings are compared
a replacement hidden-envelope gate or objective path is selected from evidence
